output_list.criticism: The function does not check for overflow when setting the initial room balance, which can lead to a denial of service.
The function does not check for overflow when updating the room balance, which can be exploited to cause a denial of service.
The function does not check for overflow when updating the room balance and transferring funds, which can lead to a denial of service.
The function does not check for overflow when updating the room balance for fees, which can lead to a denial of service.
The function does not check for overflow when distributing balances, which can lead to a denial of service.
